input: Specify the call boundary for an independent grader in the reusable eval harness.

facts: The grader must run in a fresh context.
The maker may receive structured failures after grading.
constraints: List grader inputs and forbidden inputs.

rubric.description: Limits inputs to task, rubric, and candidate output.
Returns pass or fail per criterion with one-line evidence.
Returns only structured failures to the maker.

reference.content: Start a stateless grader call with only task, rubric, and candidate output; exclude maker reasoning and self-assessment; return binary criterion results, and send only structured failures back to the maker.
